description:
Configure Vicidial to automatically email a daily call log. First, enable the 'Scheduled Reports' feature in System Settings. Then, create a new Scheduled Report with the following details:

- Scheduled ID: DAILY_LOG
- Description: Daily Compliance Export
- Report: Export Calls Report
- Run Time: 0200 (2:00 AM)
- Email to: compliance@valleyhealth.org
- Email Subject: Daily Call Export

Ensure the schedule is active and saved.
